Hello,
1) I use library "maps"  but this map don't have Ukraine boundaries, only USSR. Maybe you can advise another library with world map compatible with ggplot2.

2)1) I can't add coordinate axis using this codes

                                                subplot = geom_star(aes(r = value, angle = time), r.zero = FALSE))) + 
                                                    ggtitle("Stars") +
                                                    coord_map()

   b) ggplot(ozstars,aes(long,lat))+ map_mp +                    geom_subplot(aes(long, lat, group =  interaction(long, lat),
                                                subplot = geom_star(aes(r = value, angle = time), r.zero = FALSE))) +
